Subject: Re: Production errors during 11/30 - request for credit

Hi Karthik,

Quick summary: we saw ~25% of requests fail and increased 500ms tail latency across our production inference calls between 11/30 22:05 and 11/30 23:40 PST. Our metrics show ~3,200 failed calls and roughly 180k tokens that were retried or lost during that window. This caused a degraded experience for our pilot users and one escalated customer demo that we had scheduled.

Can Redwood provide some form of credit or trial extension? Our procurement team will need a statement of the proposed remediation to process any billing adjustments.

Thanks,
Alex

Subject: Re: Production errors during 11/30 - request for credit

Hi Alex — thanks for the detail and the snapshot. We dug into logs and correlation traces: during a cascade of collector restarts triggered by an autoscale event, we observed aggressive KV-cache evictions which forced several in-flight requests to fall back to cold compute. That explains the spike in tail latency and the failed requests you saw.

Proposed immediate remediation (so you can share with procurement):
- One-time courtesy token top-up: 150,000 generation tokens (applies immediately to your account).
- 30-day trial extension on your pilot tier (auto-applied; no action required).
- Waive any overage fees that originated from the 11/30 window.
- Schedule a 1:1 runbook review with our SREs to walk through autoscaling knobs and prefix/KV cache sizing.

Rationale: the token top-up covers the approximate lost/retried tokens plus a small buffer; we estimate the dollar-equivalent at ~$600 and the trial extension will give you breathing room for the pilot. I’ve attached our proposed calculation spreadsheet for transparency.

If this sounds good, I’ll route for approval (above $500 requires manager sign-off) and then send a DocuSign amendment for your procurement team.
